in_sanskrit.name: Greshma
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Grace, Warmth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Greshma एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Greshma means 'Warm Grace' in Sanskrit and 'Peaceful Warmth' in Hindi. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Grih' (home) and 'Sham' (warmth). This name symbolizes the feeling of being at home in one's own self and experiencing inner peace and warmth.

in_hindi.name: ग्रेश्मा

in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is present in any place, especially a temple or a house, with devotion and dedication

in_telugu.name: గ్రేశ్మా
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is the lord or master of a house

It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Grih' (home) and 'Sham' (warmth). This name symbolizes the feeling of being at home in one's own self and experiencing inner peace and warmth.
